accentColorNote: Sampled from the badge's own SVG source, which specifies no fill colour on its path and therefore renders in the SVG default of solid black. This is the wordmark rather than the six-star cluster emblem; no colour specification for either mark was found on Commons, so the mark actually on file is what is recorded rather than the widely recognised blue being guessed at.
